measurements.global_and_local_peaks: Sigmoid response values and mapped source locations, first row-major tie; local/global ratio and peak distances. Descriptive, not calibrated probabilities or a deployed selector.
measurements.component_geometry: Reproduce frozen candidates exactly; selected component weighted center, strongest pixel, nearest active support, bounding box and overlap with fixed reference disk.
measurements.contributions: Report each original contributor local/global peak and whether its local support exceeds0.3; retain individual channels and time mapping.
measurements.unknowns: No local region, center error or localization judgment for null/unsupported reference geometry. Only global/component evidence for these rows.
